# soma-stripe-demo

Live, test-mode-only reference deployment of the `soma-stripe` portable SOMA
component: a one-time donation via Stripe Checkout.

- Source of the portable component: https://github.com/eldrgeek/SOMA/tree/main/standards/soma-stripe
- This repo: https://github.com/eldrgeek/soma-stripe-demo
- Purpose: prove the click-through mechanism (donate button -> Stripe
  Checkout -> thank-you page) works end to end, entirely in Stripe test mode.
- No live/production Stripe credentials are used anywhere in this deployment.
